nativeAssessment.limitations: Two processed Jupiter views with tiny Amalthea detections; not a resolved surface map or calibrated visible colour. Original publisher JPEG and distinct dynamically served 3600px JPEG both retained with independent hashes. Their identical dimensions do not establish identical bytes or pixels. No exhaustive newest-observation claim.

Monochrome stereo presentation, differing views and illumination; right image north pole cut by camera frame. Ida bright streak origins (ejecta or ridge crest) are alternatives, not unique chemistry. No seamless globe, calibrated visible colour or local observer registration established. Source feature sizes/ranges are caption statements, not newly computed raster sizes.

Corrected Stooke 1994 bulge near latitude 0 longitude 315 caused by a smeared limb image; explicitly does not incorporate Galileo results. Decimal places do not express radius uncertainty.
shapeAudit.limitations: Existing model preserved; no modern Galileo-derived shape replacement, independent model uncertainty or physical scene registration claimed.
